probes: SELECT count(*) AS capabilities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind='limit') AS limits, count(*) FILTER (WHERE value_min IS NOT NULL OR item_pattern IS NOT NULL) AS with_domain FROM edge_bff.capabilities
SELECT capability_key, kind, value_min, value_max FROM edge_bff.capabilities WHERE capability_key LIKE 'terminal.%per%' ORDER BY 1
SELECT plan_key, is_default, for_guests, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities pc WHERE pc.plan_key = p.plan_key) AS grants FROM edge_bff.plans p ORDER BY plan_key
SELECT capability_key, value FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities WHERE plan_key = (SELECT plan_key FROM edge_bff.plans WHERE for_guests) ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS conflicts FROM edge_bff.data_scope_conflicts(NULL, NULL)

SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='edge_bff' AND (table_name, column_name) IN (('jobs','site'),('backtest_jobs','site'),('identities','sign_in_failures'),('identities','seed_verifier_sha256'),('users','test_account'),('mfa_totp','pending_nonce'),('user_capability_overrides','updated_at'),('capabilities','value_min')) ORDER BY 1,2
SELECT 'jobs' AS t, site, count(*) FROM edge_bff.jobs GROUP BY site UNION ALL SELECT 'backtest_jobs', site, count(*) FROM edge_bff.backtest_jobs GROUP BY site
SELECT pg_get_constraintdef(oid) AS def FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid='edge_bff.auth_throttle'::regclass AND conname='auth_throttle_scope_check'

SELECT p.oid::regprocedure::text AS fn, p.prosecdef AS definer FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='edge_bff' AND p.proname IN ('purge_email_outbox','capability_domain_fits','capability_domain_text','data_scope_conflicts') ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS overrides FROM edge_bff.user_capability_overrides
SELECT u.user_id, u.owner_key, i.seed_verifier_sha256 IS NOT NULL AS marked FROM edge_bff.users u JOIN edge_bff.identities i USING (user_id) WHERE i.provider='password' ORDER BY u.user_id LIMIT 3
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.capabilities) AS capabilities, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.plans) AS plans, (SELECT count(*) FROM edge_bff.auth_throttle) AS throttle_rows
